caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric with a checked plaid pattern composed of alternating squares in shades of red, dark blue-gray, and off-white. The fabric is bordered by thin red and blue lines, creating a grid. The squares vary in size and form horizontal and vertical bands that intersect, resulting in sections with mixed hues where the lines overlap. The weaving texture is visible, indicated by fine lines in the artwork. The edges of the fabric are uneven, especially on the top and left sides, and there are a couple of brownish stains toward the right edge of the drawing. The background is an off-white or beige color, which frames the fabric sample.
title: Bundle Handkerchief
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
